caption: The drawing depicts a single brown umbrella with a slightly curved, segmented canopy and a bamboo-like handle. The canopy is brown with alternating narrow, darker brown or blackish stripes running from the top center to the edges, dividing the umbrella into distinct sections. The handle is long, thin, and segmented, resembling bamboo, and it extends from the bottom center of the umbrella. The background is plain and light beige, with no other objects or elements present in the composition.
title: Parasol
